description: [$0.025] Measure what happened to every indexed launch matching your filters: rug rate against the index base rate, peak-gain percentiles, time to peak, collapse speed. Answers pattern questions like 'do launches with under 200 holders die faster?'; to shortlist live tokens to act on, use find_tokens instead. filters is {field: {min,max}} over numeric fields listed by get_coverage, e.g. {total_holders: {min: 200}}. Returns cohort aggregates and a one-sentence finding, never per-token rows. Read-only over stored history; measured past, not a forecast.

filters.description: Field bounds as {min,max}; get_coverage lists the fields.

name: test_hypothesis

cohort.description: n, rug_pct, base_rate_pct, rug_lift_vs_base, median_peak_gain_pct, p75/p90_peak_gain_pct,...

disclaimer.description: Measured history, not a forecast, and not adjusted for slippage or fees.

says.description: The finding in one plain sentence, safe to quote.
